column1: # Used only to separate English from French and Latin-script Darija on short input, which is where
# trigram statistics are weakest. It is not a stopword list — those live in the index settings.
# whatlang is trained on prose and is unreliable at query length. Restricted to the three languages
# we serve it still returned `is_reliable = false` with a small margin for most English queries,
# which fell below the confidence floor and became `Und`. Measured on the labelled set, ordinary
# English queries were detected 53% of the time. Function words are the cheap, reliable signal that
# **No entry here may also appear in `arabizi.tsv` or `french-common.tsv`.** A token in two lists
# makes every query containing it ambiguous, which is worse than having no evidence at all. There
